basis: Developmental impairment spans major 22q deletion syndromes; cardiac, immune and endocrine abnormalities depend on deletion region, with no established umbrella-wide frequency.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: cardiac defects are common in 22q11.2 deletion, but an umbrella-wide frequency of at least 30% is not established.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hypoparathyroidism and hypocalcemia are region-specific; persistent endocrine dysfunction is not established as common across this umbrella.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: immunodeficiency characterizes some 22q11.2 deletions, not chromosome 22q deletions generally; no umbrella-wide frequency is established.

basis: Ascaridida infection umbrella includes intestinal adult worms and tissue-invasive larvae; no single anatomical site consistently defines the group.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: intestinal localization defines some subtypes, whereas toxocariasis and baylisascariasis involve migrating tissue larvae; common GI involvement across the umbrella is unestablished.

basis: Metabolic myopathy; this exact subtype includes isolated muscle disease ([MedGen](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/medgen/343525)). APBD neurologic features cannot be assumed.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: the exact concept has the synonym 'adult, with isolated myopathy'; skeletal-muscle glycogen disease defines this subtype.

basis: Autoimmune lupus umbrella includes skin-limited and systemic disease; arthritis and cytopenia rates from systemic lupus cannot establish common involvement across all forms.

decisions.haematologic: none: cytopenias occur in roughly half of systemic lupus cases, but are not established in at least 30% across the umbrella including cutaneous lupus.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: inflammatory arthritis is common in systemic and drug-induced lupus, but is not a defining or established common feature across the umbrella including skin-limited lupus.

basis: Combined immunodeficiency; hearing impairment 2/2 and intellectual disability 2/4 support involvement. Bronchiectasis 1/1 assessed is a separately coded infection-related complication.

decisions.pulmonary: none: bronchiectasis is separately diagnosed damage from recurrent infections; its 1/1 assessed frequency does not overcome the separate-disease exclusion.

basis: Cohen alias ([Orphanet](https://www.orpha.net/en/disease/detail/2829)); ID, retinal dystrophy and neutropenia define it; joint laxity >30%, a major criterion; obesity omitted at cap.

decisions.haematologic: primary: Orphanet merges this historical entity into Cohen syndrome, where neutropenia is a defining blood-cell disorder.
decisions.ocular: primary: Cohen syndrome includes defining progressive retinal dystrophy and high myopia, rather than only non-damaging ocular signs.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: joint hypermobility is common (>30%) and a major criterion ([cohort](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1181995/)).

basis: Axonal neuropathy, neurodegeneration and optic atrophy define it; fixed foot contractures and muscle atrophy occur in 30-79%. Feeding difficulty is not GI damage; reflux is separately diagnosed.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: foot joint contractures and skeletal muscle atrophy occur in 30-79%; fixed contractures establish lasting musculoskeletal impairment beyond neurologic weakness alone.
